name: Embercourt Heartglass Shard
description: A blood-warm glass sliver lit from within.
specialEffects: Used in duelist blades, courtly firecraft, and emberlit ornamentation.

steps: Refine raw stock for Embercourt Heartglass Shard under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Embercourt Refinery protocol before storage.
